name: Explore Section
route: No live route; stack-pushed Explore catalog opened from Me Main [17].
annotation: Explore is Balencia's feature-discovery catalog: search and a suggested-for-you rail lead into a five-plus-domain ConstellationRadar hero, then domain sections and a more-features grid scroll below, all through selective glass with real/low-confidence/honest-null states — never a generic dashboard or a fabricated recommendation.
belowFold: Domain sections continuing below the fold: Nutrition and diet, Finance and money, Career and work, Relationships, Spirituality, Learning and growth, Creativity — same ChipDomainTag header + two-ModuleCard row pattern as Fitness and movement/Wellbeing, with locked Plus/Pro modules at 40% opacity plus lock glyph and tier word.
"more features" eyebrow + two-column ModuleCard grid for standalone tools: Journal, Habits, Calendar, Notes, Reminders, and other tools — no domain stat preview, honest-null by default.
Day 1 empty state: "Explore what Balencia can help with." replaces the suggested rail; no lock icons, no visualizations, eyebrow reads "Popular with Balencia."
Loading state: "CIA is reading your domains - one moment." shown in place of the suggested rail while recommendations fetch.
trustControls: ChipProvenance "via recent activity" on real suggested modules; low-confidence suggestions render muted with "early read · low confidence"; honest-null falls back to static "Popular with Balencia" cards — never an invented recommendation.

ConstellationRadar only draws when at least five domains are actually synced (real); low-confidence ghosts unsynced vertices; honest-null omits the radar and its heading entirely rather than drawing a fake shape.
Domain stat preview on ModuleCards: real shows 0-99 stat/level/XP progress; low-confidence shows dashed progress while sync is partial; honest-null renders a plain card with no stat preview at all.
Subscription lock badge (Plus/Pro) is entitlement-driven text-plus-lock-glyph, never color alone, and is fully hidden for users who already hold the required tier.

Search results: real = instantly filtered local catalog; server-backed rows carry "may be outdated"; true empty state reads "no modules match this search. Try a different search." — never a blank screen.
OfflineBanner keeps the cached catalog navigable and marks server-backed suggestions/community modules stale rather than hiding or faking freshness.
Locked module tap routes to Paywall [43] with trigger context — never a dead tap, per the no-dead-end rule.
notes: Route header must stay exactly "No live route; stack-pushed Explore catalog opened from Me Main [17]." — never invent a live route or vanity path.

ModuleCard and the ConstellationRadar mini variant are NEW components per source rationale: no catalog primitive covers a routable feature/domain tile with an optional lock, or a same-moment multi-axis domain recap at rail scale.
CIAInsightCard styling is reserved for recommendation rationale only — not applied to every suggested card, per source direction.
Reduced-motion path: no radar draw or stagger; domain sections render static and search changes apply instantly.
Skeleton: search, rail cards, radar axes, and module cards shimmer in final geometry, never a spinner-only placeholder.
Error: catalog remains fully navigable; failed suggestions silently fall back to "Popular with Balencia" rather than showing a broken rail.
Bottom tab bar stays visible with Me active — this is a stack push within the Me tab, not a modal takeover.

modules.build: Standard iOS status bar, dark shell: time left, signal/wifi/battery right, paper-100 icons on #0A0A0F.

TopBar, 44px back-chevron target, title "explore" (Hanken Grotesk, sentence case). No CIA glyph at header level — CIA involvement here is optional and scoped to the CIAInsightCard rationale further down, never a header-level claim.

SearchInput glass-pill, placeholder "search modules...", trailing clear (x) at 44px target, screen-reader label "Search modules". Typing crossfades the catalog to filtered ModuleCards; true empty result reads "no modules match this search. Try a different search."

Eyebrow "suggested for you" (fallback "Popular with Balencia" on Day 1 or AI failure). Horizontal ModuleCards: "Journal" badge "start here", "Sleep" badge "suggested", ChipProvenance "via recent activity". Low-confidence cards mute with "early read · low confidence".

GlassCard hero, heading "Your active *domains*" above a mini ConstellationRadar — real only when five or more domains are synced; low-confidence ghosts unsynced vertices; honest-null omits the whole card rather than faking a shape.
ChipDomainTag section header "Fitness and movement"; two ModuleCards "Workouts" and "Yoga" with dashed low-confidence progress, or an honest-null plain card when no stat exists yet.
Section header "Wellbeing"; two ModuleCards "Journal" and "Habits", clipped near the fold — remaining seven domain sections and the "more features" grid continue on scroll (see below-fold).
GlassNavBar, floating, pinned: Today · CIA · Goals · Me, Me segment active, 44px targets, overlaying the last visible catalog row per canon.
